definition: a table pastime with pieces and dice
description: In a cosy living room in the evening, three young friends sit on a sofa around a wooden coffee table covered by a colourful board game with a map board, small wooden pieces and cards. A young woman with long braids in a lilac top and denim shorts watches the board, then jumps up and throws her arms in the air, cheering. A young man in a white polo shirt laughs and moves a piece on the board, and a young woman in a cream cardigan watches. A shelf of game boxes, a floor lamp and a tabby cat are around them.

en.question: What are the three friends doing?

es.answer: Están jugando a un juego de mesa.
